stops.note: named the hourglass-shaped, double-headed drum used in worship of Sàngó and other orisha
carried to Cuba by enslaved Yoruba people and kept as a central instrument of Santería ritual
entered English through ethnomusicology and writing on Santería and Afro-Cuban music

current_meaning: a double-headed, hourglass-shaped drum of Yoruba origin, central to Santería ritual music
